source_reason: Create a Google Sheet 和 Create a Google Forms survey可以同时进行
interpretation: 原版已写 independent external branches，不能声称此前完全串行。本候选将原版主agent原生独立分支具体化为同一波两个外部writer，分别拥有Google Sheet和Form，形成可对照的子agent并行方案。仅包含已冻结分析指标的邮件保留给主agent并行发送；整体完成仍等待全部回执。
preserved_requirements: 主agent读取SLA_Policy_Reference.pdf、检查schema并用一条条件聚合计算High/Medium/Low，阈值4/8/24小时。
Total_Tickets、SLA_Compliant、0–100Compliance_Rate、Avg_CSAT、原分母与原版排名/并列规则；率和CSAT保留两位小数，输出无百分号/公式等修饰。
Support Center Performance Dashboard的SLA_Compliance和Summary，精确列与三档数据、Best_Priority和Worst_SLA_Priority。
Customer Support Satisfaction Survey恰4题，原问题和四组选项；同一表单按顺序写题。
从analytics@company.example.com向support-management@company.example.com发送指定主题和三档指标；主agent最终完成。
qualified_or_unimplemented: 原版已有独立输出分支；变化是将两个外部产物交给不同子agent明确同时启动，不把本候选描述为首次引入所有并行。
assumptions: 将“可以同时进行”落实为两个独立external coder，并保留小型读聚合在主agent；该具体实现属于候选设计而非标注者已确认方案。
任务邮件只需分析指标和发现，不消费Sheet/Form成品或宣称其完成；依赖已冻结聚合即可，整体完成仍需两writer成功。
固定email_tools.py:118–145支持from_addr，并由email_service.py:148–168传给backend；候选显式传analytics@company.example.com且核对回读From。
plan_summary: 主agent保持原规则读取与聚合并冻结数据。
同一波并发两名external coder，Sheet与Form各有唯一owner，各自读回并返回真实ID。
主agent与双writer并行发送仅含已冻结指标的指定邮件；全部回执齐备后作最终核对，不新增表单/云表→邮件屏障。
expected_tradeoff: 以额外两次委派和交接换取更显式的独立写入并发；对于紧凑产物可能增加而非减少开销，需实验比较。

changes.original: complete it directly in the main agent and dispatch no sub-agent.
changes.replacement: keep the compact read-only analysis in the main agent, then dispatch one parallel writer wave with two external-workflow-operator Coder sub-agents, one per independent resource.
changes.explanation: 仅改变独立外部写入的owner，读取计算仍由主agent承担。

changes.original: Start the independent external branches without a Wave.
changes.replacement: Wave 1 — after the main agent has frozen the aggregate, dispatch exactly two Coder sub-agents concurrently in the same response.
changes.explanation: 承认原有independent branches，将其具体化为同一波并发子agent。

changes.original: Separately call `create_form` exactly once for `Customer Support Satisfaction Survey`
changes.replacement: coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 1): Sole owner of the `Customer Support Satisfaction Survey` form.
changes.explanation: 明确Form独立owner；另一个external coder独占云表，没有跨角色授权。

changes.original: Exhaust Sent pages for exact recipient `support-management@company.example.com` and task subject, send at most once from the configured account with all three rates/CSAT values, and read the retained message.
changes.replacement: While the two writers run, the main agent independently exhausts Sent pages
changes.explanation: 独立复核恢复原邮件分支的并行性；增加两个产物writer不应给无成品依赖的分析邮件新增等待。

changes.original: send at most once from the configured account with all three rates/CSAT values,
changes.replacement: Send the missing message at most once with the supported `send_email` parameter `from_addr="analytics@company.example.com"`,
changes.explanation: 来源确认发件人覆盖能力，精确实现题面sender；不把配置账户默认地址当成已满足该要求。
